dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent light-colored 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters with sharp gradient transitions from a dark interior to a bright white/grey exterior, most defined along the upper dorsal-lateral ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity white speckles lacking internal gradients, clustered primarily on the lower lateral flank and anterior neck area.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A grouping of three prominent mid-dorsal annuli forms a roughly equilateral triangle, while a sequence of four annuli forms a curvilinear longitudinal chain along the upper lateral axis.
